title: Tuition Reimbursement True Value Calculator
description: Models the true net value of an employer tuition reimbursement benefit: IRS Section 127 tax savings, clawback risk and expected liability, study-time opportunity cost, and credential salary lift PV. Includes California AB 692 (2026) flag for stay-or-pay agreements.
regulatory_citations: CA AB 692 2026 (broadly prohibits stay-or-pay agreements for contracts signed on/after Jan 1, 2026)
